Small real STEP files for `cad-uploads.e2e-spec.ts`, written with OpenCascade (pythonocc 7.7.2), not hand-edited.

- `nested-assembly.step`: Top = 2 x Sub + 1 Cyl; Sub = 2 x Box (10x20x30 mm) + 1 Cyl (r5 x 40 mm). Two distinct part definitions.
- `plate.step`: a 40 x 30 x 3 mm block named Plate. `pin.step`: a cylinder r4 x 25 mm named Pin.
